title: Simple modules for affine nilCoxeter algebras
summary: We study the representation theory of the affine nilCoxeter algebra $A$ of type $\tilde A_{n-1}$, over a field $k$ of any characteristic. Our main theorem states that this is a Noetherian prime affine PI algebra of PI degree $n!$. As a consequence, the simple $A$-modules are all finite dimensional, and the maximum dimension of a simple module is $n!$ over a suitable finite extension of $k$. To achieve this, we investigate a large commutative subalgebra $C$ which is finitely generated as an algebra and over which $A$ is finitely generated as a module.
